note:
⛔ SNG-476. THE THREE SCHOOLS OF MIND. Erik consolidated five to three: 'the suggestions seem like mostly psionics; dialectic could be deduction and figurework mixed.'
⚠️ THE SCHOOLS ARE NOT THE SECTS. Cogitant, syllogist and figurist are the wheel poles Mind absorbed — WHERE A CRAFT DESCENDS FROM. A school is WHAT A CRAFT DOES. ⛔ They correlate and they are not the same axis: My Reality is figurist by lineage and Psionics by effect; Built System is syllogist by lineage and Figurework by effect.

Psionics._what: ⛔ THE MIND REACHING ANOTHER MIND DIRECTLY — striking it, holding it, joining it, or changing what it perceives. No vector, no contact, nothing to interpose.
Psionics._absorbed: ⚠️ ABSORBS THE SUGGESTION SCHOOL. Erik: 'the suggestions seem like mostly psionics.' ⛔ HE IS RIGHT — Ignore Me, Force the Move and Quiet the Room all work by putting something into another mind, which is the same act as Psychic Lance at a different intensity. My Reality is figurist-flavoured but the target is still a mind: everyone who enters SEES something.

Deduction._what: ⛔ THOUGHT APPLIED TO A PROBLEM AND CONVERTED INTO ADVANTAGE — a fight read, a route solved, a fault named, an argument closed, a price known.
Deduction._absorbed: ⚠️ ABSORBS MOST OF DIALECTIC. Erik: 'dialectic could be deduction and figurework mixed.' ⛔ Case Closed, Contradiction, Known Price and Physician's Tome are all REASONING TURNED ON A PROBLEM — the problem happens to be a person or an institution.

Figurework._what: ⛔ ABSTRACTION MADE PHYSICALLY REAL — a line that cuts, a threshold that holds, a figure sent to act, a structure that runs without you.
Figurework._absorbed: ⚠️ TAKES Built System from Dialectic — a system that operates in the world because its logic is sound is a figure made real, not an argument won.

_balance._note: ⚠️ Even enough. Figurework is smallest and is the most distinctive — it is the only school whose effects persist in the world without a mind attending them.
